title: The consistency rule, explained
caption: Rule breakdown: what a consistency rule is and how Tradever handles it. Check your account's rules. #tradever #propfirm #fundedtrader #futurestrading #ad @tradeverfunding @laythbanks

slides.text: A consistency rule caps how much of your profit can come from *one day*.
slides.sub: One big day can push your payout back.
On select accounts. Check the rules of yours.

slides.text: Trade your plan, not a *daily quota*.
slides.sub: Take the good days when the market gives them.
